import contextlib
import io
import os
import sys

import pytest

src = os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1])


class Collector:
    def __init__(self):
        self.results = []

    def pytest_runtest_logreport(self, report):
        if report.when == "call" or report.outcome != "passed":
            self.results.append((report.nodeid.split("::", 1)[1], report.when, report.outcome))


collector = Collector()
buffer = io.StringIO()
os.chdir(src)
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buffer):
    code = pytest.main(["-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--rootdir", src, src], plugins=[collector])
for result in sorted(collector.results):
    print(*result)
print("exit", int(code), "tests", len(collector.results))
if code != 0:
    sys.stderr.write(buffer.getvalue())
    sys.exit(1)
print("ok")
